evals.prompt: 오늘 할 일 브리핑해줘. 지난 항목, 오늘 마감, 이번 주 예정, 기한 없는 항목으로 나눠줘.
evals.expected_output: Reads a bounded incomplete reminder scope, resolves today's local date and timezone, runs the deterministic renderer, and returns overdue, due today, later this week, and no-due-date sections with exact IDs and no note bodies.
assertions: Uses list_reminder_lists and fetch_reminders with explicit calendar IDs and a limit before summarizing.
States the date and timezone basis.
Does not expose raw database paths, full JSON rows, or unrelated notes.

evals.prompt: 내일 리마인더 브리핑을 아주 간단히 보여줘.
evals.expected_output: Normalizes tomorrow to an exact date, feeds bounded MCP/EventKit JSON to render_daily_brief.py, and returns a compact version of the generated sections without widening the read.
assertions: Uses an explicit date window or bounded read.
Preserves reminder titles and IDs from tool output.
